about.headline: A motion artist who fell in love with systems.
about.summary: I design in motion and build with systems. The last five years have been broadcast graphics, 3D animation and identity work — the kind of projects where the rig matters as much as the frame. Since **2024** roughly half of my time has been on AI workflows: same instinct, different surface — figure out what the system wants to do, build the rig that lets it do it, then make it *look* like it was always supposed to feel that way.
